title: jbae-cpvp
description: Simplistic texture pack inspired by Whiteout with a modern but silly feel.
body:
This is a minimalistic texture pack used for CPvP (Crystal PvP). 

This is usually used in an anarchy setting (2b2t, 6b6t, etc).

This texture pack goes great with and is inspired by [whiteout](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mcwhiteout).

This texture pack minimizes several items and blocks, such as obsidian, netherite, and bedrock
